title: Remove 'Today', 'This Week', and 'Current Streak' from Fasting Evaluation Section

requirements.summary: Remove the three evaluation/metrics display items ('Heute', 'Diese Woche', 'Aktuelle Serie') from the IntermittentFastingPanel component while preserving the countdown timer, progress bar, fasting phase indicator, and FastingScheduleSettings.
acceptanceCriteria: The 'Heute' (Today) metric is no longer rendered in the IntermittentFastingPanel.
The 'Diese Woche' (This Week) metric is no longer rendered in the IntermittentFastingPanel.
The 'Aktuelle Serie' (Current Streak) metric is no longer rendered in the IntermittentFastingPanel.
The countdown timer, progress bar, fasting phase label, and schedule settings remain visible and functional.
No visual layout breaks or empty placeholder spaces remain where the removed items were.

file_operations.description: Remove the daily, weekly, and streak metric display items (rendered from fastingMetrics.ts) from the fasting evaluation section. Keep only the countdown timer, progress bar, fasting phase indicator, and FastingScheduleSettings component. Ensure the layout remains clean without empty gaps.
Remove this file as it provides mock fasting summary and streak data that is no longer needed after removing the evaluation metrics from the IntermittentFastingPanel.
